note: Bloomberg newsletter 30 Oct 2026 (https://www.bloomberg.com/news/newsletters/2026-10-30/why-electronic-arts-shut-down-bioware-and-cancelled-mass-effect), relayed by VGC 14:34Z and ten more outlets: EA had two costly sci-fi action games planned (the next Mass Effect and Star Wars Battlefront 3), chose Battlefront as more likely to succeed and closed BioWare; EA statement: decision after months of planning, review and analysis. Footage: Mass Effect Legendary Edition reveal trailer and two Star Wars Battlefront II Steam screenshots (EA; both Battlefront II trailers on Steam are letterboxed 816 rows or 720p, Jedi: Survivor's gameplay trailer is letterboxed 820 rows, so stills); Battlefront 3 is unannounced, so Battlefront II is stand-in, credited. Track: ME reveal trailer music from 30 s (no speech, faster-whisper).
